snippet.title: VeilWood Trailer || Available on Steam - March 2026
snippet.description:
VeilWood coming to Steam on March 20, 2026!
Steam Store Page: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3772610/VeilWood/

For the last 3 decades, the little hamlet of VeilWood has been isolated from the rest of the world by the sprawling mist. Prolonged exposure to the haze has twisted the local wildlife into bizarre beings that threaten the town. Solve the mysteries of the town and investigate the cause behind the haze distorting the region or grow complacent as the new town farmer.

~~~
